fields.Location: Intersection of Main St & Pine Ave, Riverton, VA
fields.What happened?: I was driving north on Main St with a green light. A car heading west on Pine Ave ran the red light and hit the front left of my car. The other driver said he didn't see the light. Police came and wrote a report.
fields.Damage description: Front left corner - bumper, headlight, fender and hood. Car is not drivable.
fields.Police report?: Yes - Riverton Police Dept., report RPD-26-118842
fields.Vehicle location: Towed to Riverton Auto Body, 455 Canal St, Riverton
